description: Two-rocket Saturn-vector + shared Gemmini bitstream (alveo_u250_firesim-dual-rocket-saturn-gemmini-no-nic-l2-llc4mb-ddr3). Both rockets have saturn vector; one Gemmini accelerator hangs off the system bus and is reachable from both harts via custom-3 ROCC opcodes. We model that as: hart 0 = gemmini-attached (CPU_P), hart 1 = saturn-RVV-only (CPU_E). MP_MAX_NUM_CPUS=2 in the harness conf; MODELBLASTER_POOL_THREADS=2 to match.

cores.name: rocket0
cores.description: Rocket with saturn vector + gemmini accelerator. Routes int8 conv2d/linear via gemmini's ROCC tiled_conv_auto path; falls back to scalar/RVV for ops gemmini can't accelerate.

cores.name: rocket1
cores.description: Rocket with saturn vector only (no gemmini). Handles RVV-int8 conv2d / linear, plus all the non-int8 / non-conv ops (silu, sigmoid, batchnorm, maxpool, relu, add, cat, upsample) that fall back to scalar/RVV everywhere.
